INSERT INTO schedule_runs (id, user_id, schedule_id, occurrence_at, ran_at, how, moved)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3,
                     'epoch'::timestamptz + $4::bigint * interval '1 millisecond',
                     'epoch'::timestamptz + $5::bigint * interval '1 millisecond',
                     $6, false)
             ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
